head: codex/5764-runtime-observatory-readiness
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][observatory] Repair Runtime v3 readiness probes
body:
Closes #5764

## Summary
- Add a versioned Runtime v3 `/v1/ready` readiness surface that fails closed on missing or stale weather freshness while keeping `/v1/health` truthful.
- Wire the HTML Observatory Runtime v3 path to consume `/v1/ready` before polling or secure streaming, with endpoint paths read from `demos/html-observatory/runtime-v3.config.json`.
- Update OpenAPI route inventory, CORS/readiness tests, worktree-safe Runtime v3 Vector test setup, and lifecycle records.

## Validation
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5764-target cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --test control readiness`
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5764-target cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --test control observatory_cors_allows_only_configured_origins_and_reports_canonical_port`
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5764-target cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --test openapi_contract`
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5764-target cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --test observability`
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5764-target cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml` (306 passed, 1 explicitly ignored live parity test)
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5764-target cargo fmt --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --check`
- `node --check demos/html-observatory/app.js`
- `python3 -m json.tool docs/api/runtime-v3/v1/openapi.json >/dev/null`
- `python3 -m json.tool demos/html-observatory/runtime-v3.config.json >/dev/null`
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`

## Review
